lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Semi-regular distribution of high-luminance circular pixel clusters located posterior to the gills, forming approximately four to five horizontal rows along the visible mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated luminance intersecting with the horizontal spot rows, creating a sparse grid of high-intensity nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Horizontal linear features with a high-contrast luminance gradient (light superior edge, dark inferior edge) traversing the upper quadrant of the lateral profile.
